summary: Google patched CVE-2026-85046, a V8 type-confusion vulnerability that can execute arbitrary code inside the Chrome sandbox through crafted HTML and is already exploited in the wild. CISA added the flaw to KEV on September 4. Enterprises should update Chrome to 152.0.7977.82/.83 on Windows and macOS or 152.0.7977.82 on Linux, force browser relaunches, and verify the running fleet version rather than relying only on deployment status.

title: ASCII smuggling moves from prompt injection into phishing evasion
summary: Microsoft observed a high-volume phishing campaign using invisible Unicode tag characters to split security-sensitive words and evade content-based inspection, adapting a technique better known from AI prompt injection. Defender for Office 365 still blocked more than 99% of observed messages through other detection layers, so this is not a Defender bypass. Mail-security teams should normalize or flag Unicode tag characters, test gateway handling and hunt suspicious messages where visible text differs from underlying content.

title: Unpatched Magento and Adobe Commerce zero-day is actively backdooring stores
summary: Sansec is tracking active exploitation of StyleSmuggler, an unpatched unauthenticated remote-code-execution chain affecting current Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce releases, including 2.4.9. Attacks began September 4 and install a persistent backdoor disguised as a kernel thread. Adobe has not issued a fix. Operators should apply temporary mitigations, disable GraphQL where feasible, hunt Sansec's published process, file and network indicators, invalidate sessions and rotate store, payment and integration credentials on compromised hosts.

title: JetBrains Cadence breach exposes AWS credentials through exploited TeamCity
summary: JetBrains confirmed attackers exploited CVE-2026-63077 against an unpatched TeamCity server backing Cadence and accessed a full 2024 backup, multiple AWS IAM credentials, S3 data and personal information; synchronized project source code may also have been exposed. Cadence users should treat August 8-24 executions as untrusted, rotate every secret available to jobs, and audit cloud IAM, repositories, registries, webhooks, tokens and storage for activity from JetBrains' published exploitation indicators.

title: PaperCut exploitation shifts to credential theft across schools and universities
summary: Arctic Wolf observed the actively exploited PaperCut authentication-bypass/RCE chain being used against schools and universities in the U.S. and Europe for privileged-account creation, registry-hive collection, Meterpreter payloads and searches for passwords, LDAP bind values, secrets and tokens. This is a material post-exploitation escalation beyond earlier patch reporting. Internet-facing NG/MF servers should install Emergency Patch Release 3, remove public exposure, preserve evidence and hunt pc-app.exe child processes, published IPs and credential-collection artifacts.

title: New German ransomware victims: kalahealth.eu, Stransky Heiz-Mess-Regeltechnik GmbH
summary: Ransomware.live-derived tracking added two German leak-site listings not present in the previous successful run: kalahealth.eu (Lockbit5, disclosed September 4) and Stransky Heiz-Mess-Regeltechnik GmbH (Akira, September 4). No authoritative victim statement independently confirming compromise, encryption or data theft was identified for either case. Treat both as unverified criminal claims only; defenders and partners should monitor official notices, suspicious credential or supplier activity, targeted phishing and any later publication of allegedly stolen data before escalating them to confirmed breaches.

title: MikroTik RouterOS SSH chain is actively exploited for unauthenticated takeover
summary: CERT Polska confirmed attackers are chaining RouterOS SSH flaws dubbed MikroTrick to take full control of internet-exposed devices without authentication, with successful attacks observed since at least September 2. MikroTik fixed the issues in 7.25beta3, 7.24.2, 7.23.4 and 6.49.21. Operators should patch immediately, restrict SSH and web management to trusted networks, hunt for the ops user and published SSH log patterns, and rebuild flagged devices from trusted configuration after preserving evidence.

title: N-able patches critical pre-auth N-central RCE in emergency Hotfix 4
summary: N-able released N-central 2026.3 Hotfix 4 for CVE-2026-86218, a critical pre-authentication remote-code-execution flaw in self-hosted N-central servers. The vendor says it has no confirmed production exploitation; hosted N-central instances are already patched. Because N-central provides privileged RMM access across downstream customers, on-premises operators should upgrade to 2026.3.1.14 immediately, restrict management exposure, review privileged changes and remote sessions, and rotate connected credentials if suspicious activity is found.

title: Berlin activates crisis response after Rhysida publishes stolen state data
summary: Berlin’s state government activated a central crisis unit after Rhysida published stolen data from an attack on two departments. Authorities confirmed the data release and are reviewing the material to identify affected citizens and businesses; Rhysida’s 5.79 TB figure remains an attacker claim rather than independently verified scope. German public-sector defenders should prioritize credential rotation, leak-driven phishing monitoring, preservation of incident evidence and downstream exposure assessment for data, contracts and accounts referenced in the publication.

title: BigBear phishing service bypasses Microsoft 365 MFA across 258 organizations
summary: CloudSEK gained access to the BigBear 2.0 phishing-as-a-service panel and found 258 organizations with completed Microsoft 365 MFA-bypass compromises. The Evilginx2-based infrastructure captured passwords and authenticated session cookies, used residential proxies to match victim geography, and attempted to push users away from FIDO2/WebAuthn. Defenders should revoke sessions and refresh tokens, reset exposed credentials, enforce phishing-resistant authentication and require managed devices through Conditional Access.

title: ConnectWise mitigates unpatched ScreenConnect file-transfer vulnerability
summary: ConnectWise disclosed a ScreenConnect Remote Access file-transfer issue affecting both cloud and on-premises deployments and says a permanent fix is still being prepared. No CVE or confirmed exploitation was published with the advisory, but nearly 6,000 instances are internet-exposed and ScreenConnect is a high-value MSP control plane. Administrators should temporarily remove TransferFiles or TransferFilesInSession permissions from applicable roles and session groups, restrict exposure and monitor for unusual file-transfer activity.

title: ASUS Control Center flaw enables unauthenticated root takeover of managed infrastructure
summary: ASUS published a security update for CVE-2026-75754 affecting Control Center Enterprise 4.0.0.2 and earlier. The maximum-severity chain combines missing authentication, SSRF and hard-coded credentials so a network attacker can obtain an encryption key, enable SSH on port 2222 and reach a root shell, potentially controlling the management server and managed endpoints. Operators should apply the ASUS update immediately, restrict management-plane reachability and investigate unexpected SSH enablement or access.

title: KÖRBER listed in unverified Everest ransomware claim
summary: Ransomware.live-derived tracking recorded KÖRBER, a German manufacturing and technology organization, on Everest's leak site on September 7. No authoritative victim statement or independent evidence confirming compromise, encryption or data theft was identified during this run. Treat the listing as an unverified criminal claim only; defenders, suppliers and customers should monitor for an official notification, suspicious credential or supplier activity, targeted phishing and any later publication of allegedly stolen data before escalating it to a confirmed breach.

title: CISA confirms active exploitation of critical N-able N-central RCE
summary: CISA added CVE-2026-86218 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on September 8, materially escalating the earlier N-central advisory from uncertain exploitation to confirmed in-the-wild risk. The CVSS 10 pre-authentication RCE affects self-hosted N-central before 2026.3.1.14. MSPs should install Hotfix 4 immediately, restrict management exposure, audit unexpected accounts and privileged remote sessions, and rotate downstream credentials if compromise indicators are found.

title: Adobe patches actively exploited StyleSmuggler RCE in Commerce and Magento
summary: Adobe released an urgent hotfix for CVE-2026-75650, the StyleSmuggler zero-day already being exploited against Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. The CVSS 10 flaw requires no authentication and can yield arbitrary code execution, replacing the temporary mitigations required when the campaign was first reported. Merchants should apply APSB26-146 immediately, then hunt previously exposed servers for backdoors, invalidate sessions, and rotate store, payment and integration credentials where compromise is suspected.

title: PoisonedRefresh rootkit gives attackers fileless persistence on F5 BIG-IP APM
summary: Sophos analysis of compromised F5 BIG-IP APM environments identified PoisonedRefresh, a Linux rootkit that infects Apache, survives BIG-IP upgrades and injects a PHP web shell only in memory while leaving on-disk scripts unchanged. The implant was likely deployed after exploitation of CVE-2025-53521, but the initial vector is not definitively established. Defenders should investigate Apache workers accessing /proc/self/maps, /run/bigtlog.pipe, unexpected Bash execution and suspicious HTTP 201 text/css responses, and rebuild confirmed-compromised appliances.

title: Metro listed in unverified Thegentlemen ransomware claim
summary: Ransomware.live-derived feeds now include a Germany-classified Metro listing attributed to Thegentlemen and dated September 7, not represented in the previous successful snapshot. Public enrichment around the record is inconsistent about the organization represented, and no authoritative victim statement or independent confirmation was identified. Treat it strictly as an unverified criminal listing: compromise, data theft and even the geographic attribution should not be considered confirmed until corroborated.

title: Cisco confirms active exploitation of FMC auth bypass granting root access
summary: Cisco updated its Secure Firewall Management Center advisory after confirming active exploitation of CVE-2026-20079, a CVSS 10 authentication bypass that lets unauthenticated remote attackers run scripts and commands as root. CISA added the flaw to KEV on September 9. On-premises FMC operators should apply Cisco hot fixes or fixed releases immediately, check the published license.tmp log indicator, and treat positive indicators as an incident because preventive hot fixes do not remove an existing compromise.

title: FortiGate exploitation deploys PivotC2 RAT through CVE-2025-25249
summary: SOCRadar reports ongoing exploitation of CVE-2025-25249 against FortiGate appliances, with more than 30,000 IPs targeted and 178 devices infected with the custom Node.js PivotC2 RAT. The unauthenticated heap overflow reaches the CAPWAP control service and can yield arbitrary code execution; CISA added the flaw to KEV on September 9. Operators should patch affected FortiOS and FortiSwitchManager versions, restrict UDP/5246 exposure, hunt for PivotC2 activity, and triage exposed appliances for compromise rather than relying on patching alone.

title: Passkey-themed social engineering drives Entra identity and cloud compromise
summary: Microsoft is investigating passkey- and SSO-themed social engineering in which attackers call or text employees, then steer them into adversary-in-the-middle phishing or legitimate device-code authorization flows. Successful attacks capture or obtain session tokens, bypass normal MFA value, add attacker-controlled authentication methods, enumerate Microsoft Graph and collect cloud data. Entra defenders should correlate user reports with device-code sign-ins and authentication-method changes, revoke compromised sessions, enforce phishing-resistant credentials, and restrict unmanaged-device access.

title: WatchGuard Firebox RCE is now linked to ransomware attacks
summary: CISA now flags CVE-2025-14733 as used in ransomware campaigns, materially escalating a WatchGuard Firebox flaw already known to be exploited. The unauthenticated out-of-bounds write in Fireware OS iked can yield remote code execution on vulnerable IKEv2 configurations, including some residual configuration cases; nearly 9,000 instances remain unpatched online. Operators should update to fixed Fireware releases, review WatchGuard indicators and VPN configuration, and treat positive compromise evidence as an incident rather than relying on patching alone.

title: Cisco FMC exploitation reaches Qilin ransomware and Sandworm-overlap activity
summary: Cisco Talos detailed three post-compromise clusters abusing FMC vulnerabilities, materially expanding the earlier exploitation notice. One deploys web shells and steals credentials; a second overlaps with Sandworm tooling and deploys Cyclops Blink; a third, assessed as a Qilin ransomware operator, harvested Active Directory credentials, tunneled into internal networks and deployed ransomware. Apply Cisco hotfixes immediately and hunt for license.tmp abuse, cmd.jar, web shells, reverse tunnels, Cyclops Blink and Talos-published indicators.

title: AI-orchestrated PaperCut campaign compromises 395 organizations
summary: GreyNoise observed a likely Russian-speaking actor use hundreds of AI agents to exploit CVE-2026-81578 and CVE-2026-82078 across at least 440 PaperCut instances at 395 organizations in 48 countries. The campaign harvested credentials at 280 victims, OS or domain secrets at 147 and reached domain admin at 12. Verify the latest PaperCut emergency patch, remove public management exposure, and hunt for LSASS or registry-hive collection, pass-the-hash, noPac, DCSync, Ligolo and GreyNoise's published infrastructure.

title: New German ransomware victims: alphaomega-eng.com, https://mediengruppethiel.de/, mo***al
summary: Current ransomware.live-derived data shows three German listings absent from the prior repository snapshot: alphaomega-eng.com (Lockbit5, September 10), https://mediengruppethiel.de/ (Incransom, September 9), and mo***al (Auditteam, September 9). No authoritative victim statement or independent confirmation of compromise, encryption or data theft was identified for these claims during this run. Treat all three strictly as unverified criminal listings and monitor official notices, credential or supplier abuse, targeted phishing and any later publication of allegedly stolen data.

title: BlueMoon exploit kit chains Chrome and Windows zero-days across multiple espionage groups
summary: Proofpoint observed four espionage-motivated threat actors, including China-aligned TA412/APT31, rapidly adopt the BlueMoon exploit kit from August 28. The chain combines Chrome V8 flaws CVE-2026-85046 and CVE-2026-87491 with Windows ALPC CVE-2026-85880 to escape the browser sandbox and elevate execution on supported Windows builds. All three flaws are patched. Defenders should verify current Chrome/Chromium and Windows patch levels and hunt Proofpoint's published process, file and network indicators.

title: Check Point patches two unauthenticated VPN RCE flaws in gateways and management servers
summary: Check Point patched CVE-2026-85102, an improper certificate-validation flaw during VPN negotiation, and CVE-2026-85103, an ASN.1 decoding heap overflow. Both are CVSS 9.8 issues that may allow unauthenticated remote code execution under specific conditions across Security Gateway, Spark Firewall and, for CVE-2026-85103, Security Management Server. Check Point reports no known exploitation. Apply the relevant LivePatch or Jumbo Hotfix and restrict site-to-site VPN exposure to expected peers where patching is delayed.

title: SAP OVERPASS flaw enables pre-authentication OS command execution across NetWeaver estates
summary: Onapsis disclosed OVERPASS, a CVSS 10.0 SAP kernel flaw in Extended Passport processing that is reachable before authentication over web, SAP GUI and RFC paths. Successful exploitation can execute operating-system commands with SAP administrative privileges across S/4HANA, ECC, Web Dispatcher and other NetWeaver-based systems. No in-the-wild exploitation was observed at publication. Apply SAP Security Note 3747649's kernel patch urgently, prioritizing internet-facing systems; network restrictions can reduce exposure but do not fully mitigate every attack path.

title: GitLab CVSS 10 file-read flaw is actively probed after disclosure
summary: watchTowr observed in-the-wild probing of CVE-2026-85706 within hours of GitLab's patch release. The CVSS 10 path traversal in the repository commits API lets unauthenticated attackers read arbitrary server files, potentially exposing configuration, source and CI/CD secrets. Self-managed operators should upgrade to 19.1.8, 19.2.6 or 19.3.2, hunt POST requests to repository commits endpoints containing file.path, and rotate credentials or tokens that may have been exposed.

title: CISA confirms active exploitation of ScreenConnect client file-execution flaw
summary: CISA added CVE-2026-84869 to KEV on September 11, materially escalating the earlier ScreenConnect advisory to confirmed in-the-wild exploitation. The client flaw can let a low-privileged participant in an active remote session transfer and execute files without Host authorization; ScreenConnect servers are not affected. Upgrade clients to 26.6.5, inventory recent RMM sessions, hunt unauthorized file-transfer and execution activity, and investigate affected endpoints and credentials for downstream compromise.

title: Artifactory attacks chain token flaws to admin access and persistent backdoors
summary: Wiz identified multiple actors chaining CVE-2026-42018 and CVE-2026-42016 to expose an anonymous token and escalate it to admin scope, expanding the previously covered CVE-2026-82329 threat. Post-exploitation includes persistent admin users, malicious Groovy plugins, web shells and a Rust C2 backdoor. Patch affected self-hosted Artifactory branches, hunt abnormal token endpoints and minting behavior plus Wiz IOCs, remove attacker accounts, revoke tokens and rotate CI/CD and repository secrets.

title: UNC3569 exploits Sogou one-click RCE to deploy GrayRabbit backdoor
summary: Gen Threat Labs confirmed UNC3569 actively exploited CVE-2026-51990 in Tencent's Sogou Input Method for Windows to deploy the GrayRabbit backdoor. A crafted sgbiz link chains argument injection, unrestricted webview navigation and an outdated unsandboxed Chromium engine into one-click code execution. Tencent fixed the entry point in version 16.3.0.3498. Enterprises with Chinese-language Windows fleets should verify updates and hunt Sogou child processes, suspicious links and GrayRabbit activity.

title: AI-driven ShinyHunters affiliates dump 2,100 Azure AD token sets across 40+ tenants
summary: Anthropic's September threat report documents suspected ShinyHunters affiliates using AI agents across credential harvesting, exploitation and bulk data theft. After breaching a SaaS provider, one affiliate extracted data from roughly 200 downstream customers and dumped more than 2,100 Azure AD token sets spanning over 40 corporate tenants in about 34 hours; AI agents performed nearly all the work. Defenders should prioritize session and token revocation, developer-secret discovery, cross-tenant access monitoring and Anthropic's published IOCs.

title: Attackers weaponize trusted AI platforms for ClickFix and credential-stealing malware
summary: Huntress documented attackers abusing legitimate AI-platform trust rather than breaking the platforms themselves: malicious Claude Artifacts delivered SectopRAT, a claude.ai/share lure led to MacSync theft of cookies, keychain secrets, SSH and cloud keys, and poisoned ChatGPT/Grok conversations pushed AMOS through ClickFix-style terminal commands. SOC teams should treat shared AI content and clipboard-driven execution as an attack surface, restrict script execution where practical, enforce application allowlisting and monitor scheduled tasks, security exclusions and stealer indicators.

title: Cisco Secure Email Gateway flaw is actively exploited for unauthenticated root RCE
summary: Cisco confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-76461 against Secure Email Gateway. Crafted email can exploit SQL injection in AsyncOS email parsing and reach arbitrary command execution as root; Cisco says cloud customers with detected malicious activity were contacted. There is no workaround. Upgrade on-premises appliances to a fixed release, inspect mail_logs plus external firewall telemetry for Cisco's indicators, and rebuild or restore suspected compromised appliances while renewing credentials and cryptographic material.

title: CISA confirms active exploitation of GitLab CVSS 10 path-traversal flaw
summary: CISA added CVE-2026-85706 to KEV on September 14, materially escalating earlier internet probing to confirmed in-the-wild exploitation. The unauthenticated GitLab repository-commits API path-traversal flaw can expose arbitrary server files, including configuration, source and CI/CD secrets. Self-managed operators should patch immediately, hunt POST requests to repository commits endpoints containing file.path, and rotate tokens, credentials and other secrets that may have been readable from vulnerable servers.

title: Mass scanning exploits Vite file-read flaw to steal AWS and Azure secrets
summary: F5 observed sustained mass scanning of internet-exposed Vite development servers exploiting CVE-2026-39364, with 807 attack sessions and roughly 32,000 raw events. Attackers systematically request .env files, AWS credentials, Azure tokens, Terraform state and process environment data, including traversal and encoding variants intended to evade intermediaries. Remove Vite dev servers from public exposure, upgrade to fixed versions, hunt /@fs/ requests, and rotate every secret reachable from previously exposed vulnerable hosts.

title: MedSkin Solutions Dr. Suwelack AG listed in unverified The Gentlemen ransomware claim
summary: Ransomware.live-derived tracking lists MedSkin Solutions Dr. Suwelack AG, headquartered in Billerbeck, Germany, as a The Gentlemen victim claim dated September 14. No authoritative statement from MedSkin, a regulator, CERT or police source independently confirming compromise, encryption or data theft was identified during this run. Treat the listing strictly as an unverified criminal claim and monitor official notifications, suspicious credential or supplier activity, targeted phishing and any later publication of allegedly stolen data.

title: VMware vCenter RCE is now exploited by ransomware gangs
summary: CISA updated its KEV entry for CVE-2026-59310 to flag ransomware use, materially escalating the vCenter flaw previously covered for reverse-SSH persistence. The unauthenticated Syslog directory-traversal vulnerability can reach code execution and root on vCenter, giving attackers a control-plane path toward ESXi estates; Babuk-derived encryption has been reported after compromise. Operators should verify fixed builds, remove public management exposure, hunt cron modifications, reverse SSH, web shells and new SSO administrators, and treat suspicious vCenter systems as incidents rather than patch-only cases.

title: Marimo RCE attackers pivot from notebooks into AWS bastion hosts
summary: Sysdig observed a human operator exploit CVE-2026-39987 through marimo's unauthenticated terminal WebSocket, harvest AWS credentials, retrieve a private key from Secrets Manager and reach an SSH bastion in eight seconds after reconnecting. The case shows notebook RCE immediately becoming cloud credential compromise and lateral movement. Upgrade to marimo 0.23.0 or later, remove internet exposure to /terminal/ws, rotate reachable cloud credentials and secrets, and hunt WebSocket terminal sessions, Secrets Manager calls and unusual bastion authentication.

title: Delinea Secret Server SAML flaw enables privileged-user impersonation
summary: Delinea disclosed CVE-2026-15640, a CVSS 9.5 flaw in Secret Server on-prem 10.5.0 through 12.1.3. Under certain conditions, an attacker with a valid SAML IdP response can manipulate authentication to impersonate another Secret Server user, putting privileged credentials and downstream administrative access at risk. No active exploitation has been reported. Upgrade to 12.2.7 or later, review SAML authentication and privileged-session logs, and rotate high-value secrets if suspicious impersonation activity is identified.

title: New German ransomware victims: neumerkel-gmbh.de, meterex.com
summary: Ransomware.live-derived tracking shows two German SafePay listings absent from the previous successful snapshot: neumerkel-gmbh.de (listed September 15) and meterex.com (September 15). No authoritative statement from either organization, a regulator, CERT or police source independently confirming compromise, encryption or data theft was identified during this run. Treat both strictly as unverified criminal claims; monitor official notifications, suspicious credential or supplier activity, targeted phishing and any later publication of allegedly stolen data before upgrading either case to a confirmed breach.

title: Cisco ISE zero-day is actively exploited for unauthenticated root takeover
summary: Cisco confirms active exploitation of CVE-2026-76460, a CVSS 10 API authentication bypass affecting ISE and ISE-PIC regardless of configuration. Crafted unauthenticated requests can bypass the web management interface, and successful exploitation may reach command execution as root. There is no workaround. Upgrade to a fixed patch immediately, restrict management traffic with infrastructure ACLs, inspect ISE Kong access logs and external firewall telemetry, and re-image nodes with credible exploitation evidence.

title: WSO2 API Manager JWT bypass is actively exploited with forged admin tokens
summary: watchTowr observed active exploitation attempts against CVE-2026-5430, with forged JWTs carrying administrator privileges hitting WSO2 honeypots from September 13. The signature-verification flaw can let unauthenticated attackers take over accounts across API Manager 4.1-4.6 and related control-plane, traffic-manager and gateway products, putting backend APIs, consumer keys and secrets at risk. Apply WSO2's fixed update levels immediately, review privileged API-management activity and suspicious JWTs, and rotate credentials exposed through a compromised gateway.

title: Critical Cisco FMC flaw enables unauthenticated root RCE
summary: Cisco patched CVE-2026-20242, a CVSS 9.8 Java deserialization flaw in Secure Firewall Management Center's External Database Access feature. An unauthenticated remote attacker from a host configured in the external database access list can send a crafted serialized Java byte stream and execute arbitrary commands as root. Cisco reports no known exploitation and no workaround. Upgrade affected FMC releases immediately, minimize eligible database hosts, and review management-plane and system telemetry for unexpected root-level command execution.

title: Brevo supply-chain compromise turns embedded scripts into ClickFix delivery
summary: Brevo confirmed attackers abused a stolen long-lived Cloudflare API key to create a malicious Worker that modified content at the CDN edge for about 5.5 hours on September 14. Brevo pages and JavaScript embedded on customer sites served fake Cloudflare ClickFix prompts, while logged-in WordPress administrators were targeted with a malicious plugin backdoor. Customers should review embedded Brevo exposure, investigate endpoints that executed the pasted command, and audit WordPress for unauthorized plugins.

title: Critical Unbound DNSSEC flaw can enable remote code execution
summary: NLnet Labs disclosed CVE-2026-81642 in Unbound through 1.26.0. A malicious DNS zone can return a crafted DNSKEY whose compression pointer causes a heap buffer overflow in the DNSSEC validator; attacker-controlled data makes remote code execution possible, with denial of service also expected. No active exploitation has been reported. Recursive DNS operators should upgrade to 1.26.1 or apply the vendor patch and prioritize resolvers reachable by untrusted clients.

title: Cisco fixes multiple critical Nexus Dashboard flaws with no workarounds
summary: Cisco's September 16 hardening release fixes six Nexus Dashboard CVEs with a maximum CVSS score of 9.9, covering improper access control, path traversal, missing authentication, command injection, SQL injection and credential-protection weaknesses. The issues affect Nexus Dashboard regardless of configuration; Cisco reports no known malicious use and there are no workarounds. Upgrade to 4.3.1.175 or migrate older deployments, restrict management-plane reachability, and review privileged activity around the patch window.

title: Universitt Hamburg listed in unverified Panzer ransomware claim
summary: Ransomware.live-derived tracking added Universitt Hamburg as a Panzer leak-site listing on September 18 after the previous successful run. Enrichment identifies the organization as Universität Hamburg, but no current statement from the university, a regulator, CERT or police source independently confirming compromise, encryption or data theft was identified. Treat the listing strictly as an unverified criminal claim; monitor official UHH notices, suspicious credential activity, targeted phishing and any later publication of allegedly stolen data before escalating it to a confirmed breach.

title: Orkes Conductor pre-auth RCE is actively exploited at scale
summary: Empirical Security and Fortinet telemetry confirms active exploitation of CVE-2026-58138, a CVSS 9.8 pre-authentication RCE in Orkes Conductor before 3.30.2. Malicious inline JavaScript or Python workflow expressions can escape the GraalVM evaluator and execute OS commands as the Conductor process, often root. Fortinet blocked roughly 1,300 attempts on September 8-9. Upgrade to 3.30.2 or later, remove public workflow API exposure, and hunt unexpected workflow submissions and child processes.

title: Critical Check Point management flaw enables unauthenticated root RCE
summary: Check Point patched CVE-2026-91843, a CVSS 9.8 stack overflow in the Security Management Server login path that can give an unauthenticated remote attacker arbitrary code execution as root; Log Servers and Multi-Domain deployments are also affected. No exploitation is currently known. Apply LivePatch or hotfixes immediately, restrict Trusted Clients to explicit management subnets, and review exposed management systems for anomalous login requests or post-compromise activity.

title: Plugin4Shell bypasses plugin pinning for zero-click RCE in major coding agents
summary: AIR disclosed Plugin4Shell, a zero-click plugin supply-chain RCE affecting Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot and Gemini CLI. A malicious or hijacked plugin repository can defeat SHA pinning so auto-update installs attacker-controlled code with the agent's developer permissions. Claude Code 2.1.179 and Codex 0.146.0 are fixed; AIR says Copilot remained unpatched at disclosure and deprecated Gemini CLI will not be fixed. Update or migrate, disable risky plugins, and audit agent hosts for secret exposure.

title: New German ransomware victims: hygear.com, MPA Pharma
summary: Ransomware.live-derived tracking shows two new DEU-classified listings after the previous successful snapshot: hygear.com (Lockbit5, September 18) and MPA Pharma (Rhysida, September 18). HyGear's public contact information places its main office in Arnhem, Netherlands, so the source's Germany classification may be inaccurate. MPA Pharma was already listed by Metaencryptor in August; Rhysida's new listing is a separate unverified threat-actor claim, not confirmation of a second breach. No authoritative victim confirmation was identified; treat both listings as unverified criminal claims.
